description: The plot illustrates the relationship between question popularity and three corresponding values: accuracy, confidence, and alignment. The x-axis is labeled “Question Popularity” with a linear scale ranging from 15 to 55, and tick labels are present at intervals of 5. The y-axis is labeled “Values” with a linear scale ranging from 0.86 to 1.00, and tick labels are present at intervals of 0.02.  A blue line with circular markers represents Accuracy, starting at a value of approximately 0.92 at x=15, decreasing to 0.90 at x=20, increasing to 0.97 at x=30, and ending at a value of approximately 0.98 at x=55. A green line with triangular markers represents Confidence, starting at approximately 0.98 at x=15, increasing to a peak of 0.99 at x=25, and then holding steady at approximately 0.99 for the remainder of the x-axis range. A red line with square markers represents Alignment, beginning at approximately 0.92 at x=15, decreasing to 0.90 at x=20, increasing to approximately 0.97 at x=30, and ending at approximately 0.98 at x=55.
